description.text:
Copies with the Professor Program logo or stamp, given out through the Professor Program to Pokémon Professors. The first, in the 2004-2005 season, were non-holo EX Ruby & Sapphire basic Energies and Prof. Oak's Research. Most since have been Trainer cards named for professors: a holo Professor Birch in 2006, Professor Elm's Training Method in 2007, Professor Rowan in 2007-2008 and Professor Oak's Visit in 2008-2009, crosshatch holo copies from 2011 to 2015 such as Professor Juniper and Professor Sycamore, and reverse holo copies after that.

In the Sword & Shield years the program's Exceptional Contribution Awards for Pokémon Professors included holo copies of the Galar Gym Leaders Milo, Kabu, Piers, Bea, Nessa, Opal, Melony and Raihan. Some copies came from one part of the program only: Fusion Strike's Judge from Professor University, two Scarlet & Violet Professor's Research from the Professor Store, Voltorb from Voltorb Drills, whose mentors got a cosmos reverse holo Voltorb from Scarlet & Violet 151, and Professor Sada's Vitality, Professor Turo's Scenario, Bianca's Devotion and the four Prismatic Evolutions Professor's Research from Professor Seminars. The Professor's Research promos SVP 221 to 223 and Black Bolt's Professor's Research were among the program's promos of 2026.
